title: From labelled issue to pull request

nodes.label: GitHub issue
nodes.note: Trigger is the label '@agent fix this' on an issue, or an issue comment starting '@agent fix'. The GitHub App delivers the webhook.

nodes.label: GitHub REST API
nodes.note: Where the worker pushes the run branch, opens the PR, adds the needs-review label or comments on the issue.

nodes.label: Webhook Lambda
nodes.note: app/src/webhook/handler.ts behind API Gateway. Checks the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC, detects the trigger, enqueues a work item.

nodes.label: SQS work queue
nodes.note: 5-minute visibility timeout. A message that fails 5 receives moves to a 14-day dead-letter queue.

nodes.label: Dispatcher Lambda
nodes.note: dispatcher/handler.ts. Claims the run, checks the invite allowlist, reserves a budget slot, calls ECS RunTask, releases the slot if launch fails.

nodes.label: DLQ consumer Lambda
nodes.note: dlq/handler.ts. Logs the terminal failure and comments on the issue so the reporter is not left waiting. A CloudWatch alarm fires on DLQ messages.

nodes.label: Worker bootstrap
nodes.note: __main__.py. Loads run config, mints an installation token, clones over an HTTP header (no token in the URL), makes the run branch, picks an adapter.

nodes.label: Agent loop
nodes.note: agent/loop.py. Tools: ripgrep, repo_map, read_file, edit_file, apply_patch, run_tests, finish. LimitTracker caps turns, time and cost.

nodes.label: Language adapters
nodes.note: Python adapter (uv or pip, pytest, coverage.py) and Node adapter (pnpm, yarn or npm, c8). Unsupported repos fail fast.

nodes.label: Verify and post
nodes.note: verify.py and post_result.py. Full suite plus coverage against the base commit, then PR, needs-review PR or comment. Bodies are secret-scrubbed.

nodes.label: DynamoDB
nodes.note: Three tables: runs (conditional PutItem on a hash of the delivery id), per-repo daily budgets with a TTL, and invited installations.

nodes.label: SSM Parameter Store
nodes.note: GitHub App id and private key, the webhook HMAC secret, and LLM provider keys. Plain String parameters, set after deploy.

nodes.label: LLM provider
nodes.note: worker/llm/ has Anthropic, OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible providers behind one Provider interface, chosen by LLM_PROVIDER.

nodes.label: Langfuse
nodes.note: observability.py posts one trace per run and a span per turn to the Langfuse ingestion API over httpx, and never fails the run.

flow: A labelled issue or an '@agent fix' comment triggers a webhook; the Lambda verifies the HMAC signature and enqueues a work item on SQS.
The dispatcher claims the run with a conditional write on the delivery id, checks the invite allowlist and reserves a per-repo daily slot.
It calls ECS RunTask with metadata-only overrides; the worker reads the GitHub App key from SSM and mints its own installation token.
The worker clones the repo, creates a run-scoped branch and picks the Python or Node adapter.
The agent loop searches, edits and runs tests through a path-guarded toolset until it calls finish or hits the turn, time or cost cap.
The verification gate runs the full suite and coverage in the sandbox, then opens a PR, opens it with a needs-review label, or only comments.
Secondary path: if the dispatcher keeps failing, SQS moves the message to the dead-letter queue, where a Lambda logs it and comments on the issue.
